scripts.build:backend: cp -f .env backend/.env 2>/dev/null || true; cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cp -f .env frontend/.env.local 2>/dev/null || true; cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:all: npx pm2 delete all 2>/dev/null || true; npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.restart:all: npx pm2 delete all 2>/dev/null || true; npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
